findings.fix: Factor a lemma computing `SSet.yonedaEquiv (stdSimplex.map g ≫ stdSimplex.map h)` / vertex evaluation of `stdSimplex.map`, or prove the vertex equations by `simp` with such a lemma, so each branch is one `simpa` from coneIso_inl/coneIso_inr.

findings.evidence: `have hh := (eq_of_heq (Quiver.Total.mk.inj h).2.2).trans ...`; `erw [hmap, Under.comp_right, Under.comp_right, Under.eqToHom_right, Under.eqToHom_right]`; `erw [hi, hj, ...]`.
findings.fix: Prove a lemma `(precomp F f).map (homOfLE (Fin.zero_le i.succ)) = f ≫ F.map (homOfLE (Fin.zero_le i))` once and use it with `simp`. Use `Under.eqToHom_right`/`simp` instead of the `rfl`-proved `hi`/`hj` and `erw`.
findings.issue: toUnder_precomp gets the structure-arrow equation from `eq_of_heq (Quiver.Total.mk.inj h).2.2`, then needs `erw` and `by rfl` identities for `eqToHom` on `Under.right`. This is unfolding-heavy plumbing in place of a direct statement.

summary: Proofs repeatedly unfold the comparison map with the same `change`, lean on `erw` to rewrite through definitional unfolding, and duplicate long brittle `yonedaEquiv` rewrite chains instead of factoring evaluation lemmas.
